Name: Vegetarian Bundles
Author: rinabean
Description:
This mod removes the need for fishing to complete the community centre bundles. All the fish tank bundles are replaced with vegetarian remix bundles, and the fish/seafood items in the bulletin board bundles are replaced with vegetarian alternatives.[size=2] Stardew Valley vegetarianism is funny because it includes rabbit's feet and roe :)[/size]

xnb mod, replace your Content\Data\Bundles.xnb with this file (back it up first if you want). Feel free to convert this mod to another format if you like. As far as I know, any changes to the bundles requires a new game

Thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Lefkada/about-me]Lefkada[/url] - I had a real struggle trying to extract RandomBundles.xnb, so thankfully I could use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15121]their default + remix bundle mod[/url] as a source

[size=4]Bundle changes:[/size]

River Fish Bundle > Forest Bundle (moss and seeds for charcoal kiln)

Lake Fish Bundle > Garden Bundle (flowers for bee house [size=2]- Lefkada's change, more fun than a quality sprinkler[/size])

Ocean Fish Bundle > Brewer's Bundle (drinks for keg)

Night Fishing Bundle > Sticky Bundle (sap for glow ring [size=2]- same reward as original, instead of another charcoal kiln[/size])

Specialty Fish Bundle > Treasure Hunter's Bundle (gems for lucky lunch [size=2]- just pretend it's a veg version[/size])

Crab Pot Bundle > Forager's Bundle (berries for taps)

[size=4]Item changes:[/size]

In the Chef's Bundle: Maki Roll > Goat's Cheese

In the Dye Bundle: Sea Urchin > Amaranth[size=2] (it was already a remix option, too)[/size]

In the Field Research Bundle: Chub > Rainbow Shell
